about: Magit (git operations). No display is carried; only computed results are returned

intents.title: Changed files (a table)
intents.desc: The untracked, unstaged and staged files of the repository of default-directory, each a plist (:section :path -- absolute), drawn as a table in the decode_emacs panel (s stage, u unstage, d against HEAD, C commit: the message written in a code_vi_minimum, H the file's hunks in a table of their own, X discards an unstaged change or an untracked file -- pressed twice); run from magit.changed-files makes the same rows a run_table that stages them one by one (magit_stage)

emacs.form: (let ((top (magit-toplevel))) (unless top (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory)) (vconcat (append (mapcar (lambda (f) (list :section "untracked" :path (expand-file-name f top))) (magit-untracked-files)) (mapcar (lambda (f) (list :section "unstaged" :path (expand-file-name f top))) (magit-unstaged-files)) (mapcar (lambda (f) (list :section "staged" :path (expand-file-name f top))) (magit-staged-files)))))

intents.notes: D-decode-emacs; result.book: run from magit.changed-files makes a run_table of tasks/run/magit_stage.json (D-run-table). The repository is default-directory's (the buffer current in Emacs), as the other magit.* intents. Paths are absolute (expand-file-name against magit-toplevel) so the panel can make them paths from the FS root. A file both staged and changed again shows in both sections. A big repository with very many untracked files may take Emacs more than the resolver's 3 s (measured 2026-10-23: 40 MB arrive in 2 s; what stops an answer is Emacs taking more than 3 s to make it)

intents.title: Unstaged files
intents.desc: Return magit-unstaged-files as a list (no display is carried)

emacs.form: (vconcat (magit-unstaged-files))

intents.notes: A pure query; also the target of the stage intents' post.refresh. An unconditional vconcat makes it an array whether empty or not

intents.title: Staged files
intents.desc: Return magit-staged-files as a list

emacs.form: (vconcat (magit-staged-files))

intents.title: Stage file
intents.desc: git add with magit-stage-files (independent of the buffer position)

params.name: path
params.doc: pick from the unstaged list; resolved from default-directory

emacs.form: (progn (magit-stage-files (list {{path}})) nil)

intents.notes: Not affected by rebinding (a function call, not a keymap lookup). A form whose value is not used ends in nil -- the wrapper turns nil into JSON null, so the form does not write :null. idempotent is about re-running this form only; post.refresh is protected by its own debounce. The function is magit-stage-files (plural, takes a list of files): a single file is passed as (list path)

intents.title: Unstage file
intents.desc: The equivalent of git reset HEAD with magit-unstage-files (independent of the buffer position)

params.name: path
params.doc: pick from the staged list

emacs.form: (progn (magit-unstage-files (list {{path}})) nil)

intents.notes: The counterpart of magit.stage-file; the plural API (magit-unstage-files) is called with a one-element list

intents.title: Commit (no editor buffer)
intents.desc: Run `git commit -m <message>` directly with magit-run-git. magit-commit is not used -- with-editor does not work without emacsclient wired up

params.name: message
params.doc: the commit message (may be several lines; \n is escaped automatically)

emacs.form: (magit-run-git "commit" "-m" {{message}})

intents.notes: magit-run-git runs synchronously and returns git's exit code (an integer); it is a plain function call. The ok payload is that exit code -- 0 is success, non-zero a failure (e.g. nothing staged). git does not signal an elisp error, so a failure comes back as ok <non-zero>, not err. idempotent means running it twice breaks nothing -- the second run after a success finds nothing staged and returns non-zero; there is no double commit

intents.title: A file as it is in HEAD
intents.desc: The text of <path> (absolute) as it is in HEAD -- the decode_emacs panel compares it with the file (code_diff). Empty when HEAD has no such file

params.name: path
params.doc: an absolute path in a git repository

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel (file-name-directory {{path}})) (error "not in a git repository: %s" {{path}}))) (default-directory top)) (magit-git-output "show" (concat "HEAD:" (file-relative-name {{path}} top))))

intents.notes: magit-git-output returns git's whole output as a string (magit-git-string would give the first line only) and an empty string when git fails (a file HEAD does not have: compared as empty). The size of the answer is no limit (measured 2026-10-23: 40 MB arrive in 2 s; what stops an answer is Emacs taking more than 3 s to make it)

intents.title: Log (a table)
intents.desc: The last commits of <rev> (default HEAD), each a plist (:rev short :date :author :subject), drawn as a table in decode_emacs (f: the commit's files in a table of their own)

params.name: count
params.doc: how many commits (default 50: the answer must fit the message channel)

params.name: rev
params.doc: where the log starts (a branch, a hash ...)

emacs.form: (let ((default-directory (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory)))) (vconcat (mapcar (lambda (l) (let ((f (split-string l "\x1f"))) (list :rev (nth 0 f) :date (nth 1 f) :author (nth 2 f) :subject (nth 3 f)))) (magit-git-lines "log" (format "-n%d" {{count}}) "--date=short" "--format=%h\x1f%ad\x1f%an\x1f%s" {{rev}} "--"))))

intents.notes: D-decode-emacs. git log through magit-git-lines; fields split by \x1f (not in a subject). count has a default (params[].default), raised per call (table magit.log count=3000: 420 KB in 0.3 s, measured 2026-10-23) as long as Emacs makes it within 3 s

intents.title: A commit's files (a table)
intents.desc: The files a commit changed (git diff-tree -M --root), each a plist (:status A/M/D/R... :path :old -- absolute, :old the name before a rename -- :rev :parent); d compares the file at the parent with the file at the commit (code_diff), R restores the file as it is at the commit (pressed twice)

params.name: rev
params.doc: the commit (a hash, HEAD ...)

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (rev {{rev}}) (parent (or (magit-git-string "rev-parse" "--short" "--verify" "-q" (concat rev "^")) (magit-git-string "hash-object" "-t" "tree" "/dev/null")))) (vconcat (mapcar (lambda (l) (let ((f (split-string l "\t"))) (list :status (substring (car f) 0 1) :path (expand-file-name (car (last f)) top) :old (expand-file-name (nth 1 f) top) :rev rev :parent parent))) (magit-git-lines "-c" "core.quotePath=false" "diff-tree" "--no-commit-id" "-r" "-M" "--root" "--name-status" rev))))

intents.notes: D-decode-emacs. The parent of a root commit is the empty tree (every file comes out empty there). Enter opens the file as it is now (not at the commit)

intents.title: A file at a revision
intents.desc: The text of <path> (absolute) at <rev>; rev empty: as it is in the index. Empty when <rev> has no such file

params.name: path
params.doc: an absolute path in the repository

params.name: rev
params.doc: a commit, a tree; empty: the index (git's :path)

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top)) (magit-git-output "show" (concat {{rev}} ":" (file-relative-name {{path}} top))))

intents.notes: magit-git-output gives an empty string when git fails (no such file there). The repository is default-directory's, as the other magit.* intents (a file deleted since has no directory to ask). The size of the answer is no limit (measured 2026-10-23: 40 MB arrive in 2 s; what stops an answer is Emacs taking more than 3 s to make it)

intents.title: Hunks (a table)
intents.desc: The hunks of the unstaged and staged changes (of <path> only, if given), each a plist (:section :path :n -- its number in the file -- :line -- where it starts now -- :header -- its @@ line -- :base); s stages, u unstages one, Enter opens the file at it, d compares the file with its base (unstaged: the index; staged: HEAD), X discards an unstaged hunk from the working tree (pressed twice)

params.name: path
params.doc: one file (absolute); empty: every changed file

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (only {{path}}) (rows nil)) (dolist (sec (list "unstaged" "staged")) (dolist (f (if (equal sec "staged") (magit-staged-files) (magit-unstaged-files))) (when (or (equal only "") (equal (expand-file-name f top) only)) (let ((n 0)) (dolist (l (split-string (magit-git-output "diff" "--no-color" "--no-ext-diff" "-U3" (and (equal sec "staged") "--cached") "--" f) "\n")) (when (string-match "^@@ -[0-9,]+ \\+\\([0-9]+\\)" l) (setq n (1+ n)) (push (list :section sec :path (expand-file-name f top) :n n :line (string-to-number (match-string 1 l)) :header l :base (if (equal sec "staged") "HEAD" "")) rows))))))) (vconcat (nreverse rows)))

intents.notes: D-decode-emacs. git diff -U3 per file (magit-unstaged-files / magit-staged-files: no paths read out of the diff). Only the @@ lines are returned, not the hunks' text (a table of headers to choose from); d shows the whole file against its base. Untracked files have no hunks (stage them as files)

intents.title: Stage a hunk
intents.desc: Stage the hunk <n> of <path>'s unstaged changes: the diff is made again in Emacs, its @@ line checked against <header>, and that hunk applied to the index (git apply --cached)

params.name: section
params.doc: the hunk's section (a row of magit.hunks)

params.name: path
params.doc: the file, absolute

params.name: n
params.doc: the hunk's number in the file (from 1)

params.name: header
params.doc: its @@ line as listed: checked before applying

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (staged nil) (f (file-relative-name {{path}} top)) (n {{n}})) (unless (equal {{section}} "unstaged") (error "stage: a hunk of the unstaged section only")) (with-temp-buffer (insert (magit-git-output "diff" "--no-color" "--no-ext-diff" "-U3" "--src-prefix=a/" "--dst-prefix=b/" (and staged "--cached") "--" f)) (goto-char (point-min)) (let ((starts nil)) (while (re-search-forward "^@@ " nil t) (push (match-beginning 0) starts)) (setq starts (nreverse starts)) (let* ((beg (nth (1- n) starts)) (end (or (nth n starts) (point-max)))) (unless (and beg (equal {{header}} (buffer-substring beg (save-excursion (goto-char beg) (line-end-position))))) (error "the hunk %d of %s changed: ask again (r)" n f)) (let ((patch (concat (buffer-substring (point-min) (car starts)) (buffer-substring beg end)))) (erase-buffer) (insert patch) (let ((code (apply (function magit-run-git-with-input) "apply" "--cached" (append (and staged (list "--reverse")) (list "-"))))) (unless (eq code 0) (error "git apply exited %s" code)) nil))))))

intents.notes: Tezcatl carries only which hunk (n and its @@ line); the patch is cut from git's own diff in Emacs. A changed file (the @@ line differs) is refused: ask again (r). magit-run-git-with-input takes the temporary buffer as stdin and returns the exit code

intents.title: Unstage a hunk
intents.desc: Unstage the hunk <n> of <path>'s staged changes (git apply --cached --reverse of that hunk of git diff --cached)

params.name: section
params.doc: the hunk's section (a row of magit.hunks)

params.name: path
params.doc: the file, absolute

params.name: n
params.doc: the hunk's number in the file (from 1)

params.name: header
params.doc: its @@ line as listed: checked before applying

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (staged t) (f (file-relative-name {{path}} top)) (n {{n}})) (unless (equal {{section}} "staged") (error "unstage: a hunk of the staged section only")) (with-temp-buffer (insert (magit-git-output "diff" "--no-color" "--no-ext-diff" "-U3" "--src-prefix=a/" "--dst-prefix=b/" (and staged "--cached") "--" f)) (goto-char (point-min)) (let ((starts nil)) (while (re-search-forward "^@@ " nil t) (push (match-beginning 0) starts)) (setq starts (nreverse starts)) (let* ((beg (nth (1- n) starts)) (end (or (nth n starts) (point-max)))) (unless (and beg (equal {{header}} (buffer-substring beg (save-excursion (goto-char beg) (line-end-position))))) (error "the hunk %d of %s changed: ask again (r)" n f)) (let ((patch (concat (buffer-substring (point-min) (car starts)) (buffer-substring beg end)))) (erase-buffer) (insert patch) (let ((code (apply (function magit-run-git-with-input) "apply" "--cached" (append (and staged (list "--reverse")) (list "-"))))) (unless (eq code 0) (error "git apply exited %s" code)) nil))))))

intents.notes: The counterpart of magit.stage-hunk

intents.title: Branches (a table)
intents.desc: The local branches of the repository of default-directory, each a plist (:current -- * on the branch checked out -- :branch :upstream :ahead :behind -- commits not in the upstream and the upstream's not here, as of the last fetch), drawn as a table in decode_emacs: Enter or o checks the row's branch out, n makes a new branch from the row's and checks it out (its name written in a code_vi_minimum), f fetches, F pulls into the current branch (--ff-only), P pushes the row's branch to its upstream

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (cur (magit-get-current-branch))) (vconcat (mapcar (lambda (b) (let* ((up (magit-get-upstream-branch b)) (n (and up (magit-rev-diff-count b up)))) (list :current (if (equal b cur) "*" "") :branch (substring-no-properties b) :upstream (if up (substring-no-properties up) "") :ahead (if n (car n) "") :behind (if n (cadr n) "")))) (magit-list-local-branch-names))))

intents.notes: D-decode-emacs. magit-list-local-branch-names; ahead / behind by magit-rev-diff-count against the upstream (empty with no upstream). Remote branches are not listed. f, F and P are later intents (D-intent-later): the table is asked again when they end

intents.title: Check a branch out
intents.desc: git checkout <branch> -- (git decides about uncommitted changes: they come along unless they conflict, then git refuses and says why); afterwards check update all in the frame used last

params.name: branch
params.doc: a local branch

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (b {{branch}})) (when (or (equal b "") (string-prefix-p "-" b)) (error "not a branch name: %s" b)) (with-temp-buffer (let ((code (apply (function magit-process-git) t (list "checkout" b "--")))) (unless (eq code 0) (error "git checkout exited %s: %s" code (string-trim (buffer-string)))))) (ignore-errors (magit-refresh)) nil)

intents.notes: magit-process-git into a temporary buffer: git's own words come back in the error when it refuses. magit-refresh afterwards reverts the buffers Emacs visits (magit-auto-revert-mode); code_editors are asked by check.update-all (post.commands)

intents.title: Make a branch and check it out
intents.desc: git checkout -b <name> <from> (from: a branch or commit; empty: HEAD); afterwards check update all

params.name: name
params.doc: the new branch's name

params.name: from
params.doc: where it starts (empty: HEAD)

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (b (string-trim {{name}})) (from {{from}})) (when (or (equal b "") (string-prefix-p "-" b)) (error "not a branch name: %s" b)) (with-temp-buffer (let ((code (apply (function magit-process-git) t (list "checkout" "-b" b (if (equal from "") "HEAD" from))))) (unless (eq code 0) (error "git checkout -b exited %s: %s" code (string-trim (buffer-string)))))) (ignore-errors (magit-refresh)) nil)

intents.notes: A name git refuses (a branch already there, a bad name) comes back as git said it. No upstream is set: the first magit.push needs set-upstream=<remote>

intents.title: Fetch
intents.desc: git fetch [<remote>] (empty: git's default remote), a later intent: answered when git ends

params.name: remote
params.doc: a remote (empty: git's default)

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (r {{remote}}) (p (magit-start-git nil "fetch" (and (not (equal r "")) r)))) (process-put p (quote tez-output) (lambda (proc) (let ((s (process-get proc (quote section)))) (if (and s (oref s content)) (with-current-buffer (process-buffer proc) (progn (require (quote ansi-color)) (string-trim (ansi-color-filter-apply (buffer-substring-no-properties (oref s content) (oref s end)))))) "")))) p)

intents.notes: D-intent-later: magit-start-git (Magit's process: its prompts for a passphrase or password come up in Emacs' minibuffer, answered by typing to Emacs from the input line); tez-output is the process' section of the magit-process buffer

intents.title: Pull (fast-forward only)
intents.desc: git pull --ff-only into the current branch from its upstream, a later intent; a branch that has gone apart is refused by git as it says; afterwards check update all

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (b (or (magit-get-current-branch) (error "HEAD is detached: no current branch"))) (p (if (magit-get-upstream-branch b) (magit-start-git nil "pull" "--ff-only") (error "%s has no upstream: nothing to pull from" b)))) (process-put p (quote tez-output) (lambda (proc) (let ((s (process-get proc (quote section)))) (if (and s (oref s content)) (with-current-buffer (process-buffer proc) (progn (require (quote ansi-color)) (string-trim (ansi-color-filter-apply (buffer-substring-no-properties (oref s content) (oref s end)))))) "")))) p)

intents.notes: D-intent-later. Merging and rebasing are not offered (a conflict cannot be carried through to its end in a table); --ff-only refuses rather than makes a merge

intents.title: Push to the upstream
intents.desc: git push of <branch> (empty: the current one) to its upstream only, a later intent; with set-upstream=<remote>: git push -u <remote> <branch> (makes the upstream). No upstream and no set-upstream: refused. No force

params.name: branch
params.doc: a local branch (empty: the current one)

params.name: set-upstream
params.doc: a remote: push there and make it the upstream

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (b (if (equal {{branch}} "") (or (magit-get-current-branch) (error "HEAD is detached: name a branch")) {{branch}})) (su {{set-upstream}}) (remote (magit-get "branch" b "remote")) (merge (magit-get "branch" b "merge")) (p (progn (when (or (equal b "") (string-prefix-p "-" b)) (error "not a branch name: %s" b)) (cond ((not (equal su "")) (magit-start-git nil "push" "-u" su (concat "refs/heads/" b))) ((and remote merge (not (equal remote "."))) (magit-start-git nil "push" remote (concat "refs/heads/" b ":" merge))) (t (error "%s has no upstream: magit.push set-upstream=<remote> (e.g. origin)" b)))))) (process-put p (quote tez-output) (lambda (proc) (let ((s (process-get proc (quote section)))) (if (and s (oref s content)) (with-current-buffer (process-buffer proc) (progn (require (quote ansi-color)) (string-trim (ansi-color-filter-apply (buffer-substring-no-properties (oref s content) (oref s end)))))) "")))) p)

intents.notes: D-intent-later. The destination is branch.<b>.remote and branch.<b>.merge, named in full (push.default and pushRemote are not used); a branch whose upstream is local (remote ".") is refused as having none. Force is not offered (discarding waits for a confirmation, issues.md)

intents.title: Stashes (a table)
intents.desc: The stashes of the repository of default-directory, newest first, each a plist (:stash -- stash@{n} -- :rev :date :message), drawn as a table in decode_emacs: z stashes the changes (its message written in a code_vi_minimum), p pops the row's stash, a applies it (the stash kept), X drops it (pressed twice)

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top)) (vconcat (mapcar (lambda (l) (let ((f (split-string l "\x1f"))) (list :stash (nth 0 f) :rev (nth 1 f) :date (nth 2 f) :message (nth 3 f)))) (magit-git-lines "stash" "list" "--format=%gd\x1f%h\x1f%cs\x1f%gs"))))

intents.notes: D-decode-emacs. git stash list (%gd is stash@{n} -- never with --date, which makes it stash@{<date>}; %cs the date; fields split by \x1f). X (magit.stash-drop) asks for a second press (D-discard-confirm)

intents.title: Stash the changes
intents.desc: Stash the changes of the index and the working tree with Magit's magit-stash-save (untracked=true: untracked files too), the message given or WIP on <branch>; Magit refuses when there is nothing to save; afterwards check update all

params.name: message
params.doc: the stash's message (empty: git's own, WIP on <branch>)

params.name: untracked
params.doc: stash untracked files too

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (msg (string-trim {{message}})) (u (eq {{untracked}} t))) (magit-stash-save (if (equal msg "") (format "WIP on %s" (or (magit-get-current-branch) "HEAD")) msg) t t (and u t) t) nil)

intents.notes: magit-stash-save (message index worktree untracked refresh), not git stash push: Magit gives git --literal-pathspecs, under which git stash push --include-untracked stores the untracked files but leaves them in the working tree (found in a batch Emacs, 2026-10-23). Magit refuses with 'No local changes to save' (a user-error: the err path). A bool param is t or :false (both non-nil in Elisp): (eq … t)

intents.title: Pop a stash
intents.desc: git stash pop <stash>: its changes back into the working tree and the stash dropped; when git refuses (a file it would overwrite, a conflict) its words come back and the stash stays; afterwards check update all

params.name: stash
params.doc: stash@{<n>} (a row of magit.stashes)

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (r {{stash}})) (unless (string-match-p "\\`stash@{[0-9]+}\\'" r) (error "not a stash: %s (stash@{<n>})" r)) (with-temp-buffer (let ((code (apply (function magit-process-git) t (list "stash" "pop" r)))) (unless (eq code 0) (error "git stash pop exited %s: %s" code (string-trim (buffer-string)))))) (ignore-errors (magit-refresh)) nil)

intents.notes: On a conflict git applies what it can, leaves conflict markers, keeps the stash and exits non-zero: an error with git's words, and check.update-all shows the files changed

intents.title: Apply a stash
intents.desc: git stash apply <stash>: its changes back into the working tree, the stash kept; git's words when it refuses; afterwards check update all

params.name: stash
params.doc: stash@{<n>} (a row of magit.stashes)

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (r {{stash}})) (unless (string-match-p "\\`stash@{[0-9]+}\\'" r) (error "not a stash: %s (stash@{<n>})" r)) (with-temp-buffer (let ((code (apply (function magit-process-git) t (list "stash" "apply" r)))) (unless (eq code 0) (error "git stash apply exited %s: %s" code (string-trim (buffer-string)))))) (ignore-errors (magit-refresh)) nil)

intents.notes: The counterpart of magit.stash-pop that keeps the stash

intents.title: Discard a file's change
intents.desc: Discards what cannot be had back (D-discard-confirm): an unstaged change -- the working tree back to the index (git restore --worktree) -- or an untracked file, moved to the trash (Magit's magit-delete-by-moving-to-trash). A staged row is refused: unstage it first (u). Afterwards check update all

params.name: section
params.doc: unstaged or untracked (a row of magit.changed-files)

params.name: path
params.doc: the file, absolute

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (f (file-relative-name {{path}} top)) (sec {{section}})) (cond ((equal sec "unstaged") (unless (member f (magit-unstaged-files)) (error "%s has no unstaged change: ask again (r)" f)) (with-temp-buffer (let ((code (apply (function magit-process-git) t (list "restore" "--worktree" "--" f)))) (unless (eq code 0) (error "git restore exited %s: %s" code (string-trim (buffer-string))))))) ((equal sec "untracked") (unless (member f (magit-untracked-files)) (error "%s is not untracked: ask again (r)" f)) (let ((delete-by-moving-to-trash magit-delete-by-moving-to-trash)) (delete-file (expand-file-name f top) t))) ((equal sec "staged") (error "%s is staged: unstage it first (u), then discard" f)) (t (error "not a section of magit.changed-files: %s" sec))) (ignore-errors (magit-refresh)) nil)

intents.notes: D-discard-confirm: runs only on a second press of X, or intent! magit.discard-file. Not magit-discard-files (it asks y/n in Emacs' minibuffer). A staged row is refused so that the staged and the unstaged changes of one file are never lost together. The trash is Emacs' (delete-file with TRASH moves to it only while delete-by-moving-to-trash is non-nil: bound to magit-delete-by-moving-to-trash, as Magit does; the freedesktop trash under XDG_DATA_HOME). With magit-delete-by-moving-to-trash nil the file is deleted

intents.title: Discard a hunk
intents.desc: Discards what cannot be had back (D-discard-confirm): the hunk <n> of <path>'s unstaged changes taken out of the working tree (git apply --reverse of that hunk of git diff), its @@ line checked first; afterwards check update all

params.name: section
params.doc: the hunk's section (a row of magit.hunks)

params.name: path
params.doc: the file, absolute

params.name: n
params.doc: the hunk's number in the file (from 1)

params.name: header
params.doc: its @@ line as listed: checked before applying

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (staged nil) (f (file-relative-name {{path}} top)) (n {{n}})) (unless (equal {{section}} "unstaged") (error "discard: a hunk of the unstaged section only (unstage it first: u)")) (with-temp-buffer (insert (magit-git-output "diff" "--no-color" "--no-ext-diff" "-U3" "--src-prefix=a/" "--dst-prefix=b/" (and staged "--cached") "--" f)) (goto-char (point-min)) (let ((starts nil)) (while (re-search-forward "^@@ " nil t) (push (match-beginning 0) starts)) (setq starts (nreverse starts)) (let* ((beg (nth (1- n) starts)) (end (or (nth n starts) (point-max)))) (unless (and beg (equal {{header}} (buffer-substring beg (save-excursion (goto-char beg) (line-end-position))))) (error "the hunk %d of %s changed: ask again (r)" n f)) (let ((patch (concat (buffer-substring (point-min) (car starts)) (buffer-substring beg end)))) (erase-buffer) (insert patch) (let ((code (apply (function magit-run-git-with-input) "apply" "--reverse" (list "-")))) (unless (eq code 0) (error "git apply exited %s" code)) (ignore-errors (magit-refresh)) nil))))))

intents.notes: magit.stage-hunk's form with git apply --reverse on the working tree instead of --cached on the index. A changed file (the @@ line differs) is refused: ask again (r)

intents.title: Restore a file as at a revision
intents.desc: Discards what cannot be had back (D-discard-confirm): the file <path> in the index and the working tree made what it is at <rev> (git restore --source=<rev> --staged --worktree); a file the revision does not have is refused by git (a file deleted in that commit: rev=<its parent>). Afterwards check update all

params.name: path
params.doc: the file, absolute

params.name: rev
params.doc: a commit (default HEAD)

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (f (file-relative-name {{path}} top)) (rev {{rev}})) (when (string-prefix-p "-" rev) (error "not a revision: %s" rev)) (with-temp-buffer (let ((code (apply (function magit-process-git) t (list "restore" (concat "--source=" rev) "--staged" "--worktree" "--" f)))) (unless (eq code 0) (error "git restore exited %s: %s" code (string-trim (buffer-string)))))) (ignore-errors (magit-refresh)) nil)

intents.notes: R in magit.commit-files: the file as at the row's commit. Both the index and the working tree: what was staged of that file is gone too

intents.title: Drop a stash
intents.desc: Discards what cannot be had back (D-discard-confirm): git stash drop <stash>

params.name: stash
params.doc: stash@{<n>} (a row of magit.stashes)

emacs.form: (let* ((top (or (magit-toplevel) (error "not in a git repository: %s" default-directory))) (default-directory top) (r {{stash}})) (unless (string-match-p "\\`stash@{[0-9]+}\\'" r) (error "not a stash: %s (stash@{<n>})" r)) (with-temp-buffer (let ((code (apply (function magit-process-git) t (list "stash" "drop" r)))) (unless (eq code 0) (error "git stash drop exited %s: %s" code (string-trim (buffer-string)))))) (ignore-errors (magit-refresh)) nil)

intents.notes: The working tree is not touched, so no check.update-all
